changelog:
Major new release with energy-optimized planning and built-in accountability.

- Introduces a consistent, research-backed daily planning framework (circadian and GTD principles)
- Automatically time-blocks tasks based on energy levels and personal constraints
- Supports custom energy profiles and real calendar integration
- Enforces buffer times, breaks, and “no overwork” boundaries
- Tracks completion and offers an evening reflection process for continuous improvement
- Output is a clear, hour-by-hour Markdown plan ready to use
summary: Generate an energy-optimized, time-blocked daily plan based on circadian rhythm research and GTD principles
